name: Pasar Dacing Steelyard Scale
summary: Original hanging dacing scale with a visible poised beam and fixed mango sample.
description: Original Malaysian pasar-inspired hanging dacing with a short-arm brass sample pan, fixed fulcrum and long-arm sliding counterweight. Balance the staged mangoes to see the beam level in a 3D illustration; no actual weighing or calibration.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original procedural display, asymmetric brass beam, open mechanical slider collar, suspended sample pan and four deterministic baked tracks; Cycles studio still.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Illustrative only. No actual weighing, calibration, commerce, historic museum replica or engineering claim. Blender +Z up, -Y outward; glTF +Y up, +Z outward; illustrative metres.
